messages.content: Write a monthly engineering update for a team of twelve, covering a migration, two hires, and a slipped deadline. Around 200 words.

Engineering Update — August 2026

The database migration finished last week. We moved the primary datastore off the old cluster without downtime, and the team spent the back half of the month watching dashboards and fixing the handful of query patterns that didn't translate cleanly. Thanks to everyone who took an on-call shift during the cutover.

Two new engineers joined us this month: Priya Nair on the platform team and Marcus Webb on infrastructure. Both are ramping up on the codebase now — say hello if you haven't already, and pair with them where you can.

On the downside, the reporting API redesign is not shipping this month. We underestimated how much the migration work would eat into the sprint, and the two overlapped more than planned. The new target is mid-October. If your team depends on the new endpoints, expect the current API to stay stable until then — no breaking changes are coming before the new release.

Overall a heavy month: one big infrastructure change closed out, two people onboarded, one deadline pushed. Priorities for September are stabilizing the new database setup, getting Priya and Marcus fully ramped, and restarting the reporting API work with a more realistic timeline.

Change nothing else, and keep the same length and purpose.
